test_str_join: test str.join() on a Series with nulls using ignore_nulls=False to propagate nulls and ignore_nulls=True to skip them
test_str_join2: test str.join() on a DataFrame column with null values, asserting None propagation and null-ignored concatenation
test_str_join_all_null: test str.join() on an all-null Series, verifying None propagation and empty string output when ignoring nulls
test_str_join_empty_list: test str.join() on an empty Series, verifying empty string output for both ignore_nulls modes
test_str_join_datetime: test str.join() on a Series of datetime values with ignore_nulls=True to concatenate non-null datetimes
